raw_text: Former prime minister Imran Khan was arrested by paramilitary Rangers in dramatic fashion from the premises of Islamabad High Court on Tuesday. Within hours, violent protests broke out across Pakistan with PTI supporters attacking military installations in Lahore and Rawalpindi. The government imposed a nationwide internet blackout and announced deployment of the army under Article 245 of the constitution.
clean_text: Imran Khan arrested by Rangers at IHC. Violent protests across Pakistan. Military installations attacked. Nationwide internet blackout imposed, army deployed under Article 245.
